brief.decision: Which question should the first-class booking guide answer first?
brief.objective: Help a first-time participant decide whether to bring their own garment.
brief.assumption: First-time learners primarily want to reserve several seats.
constraints: Use the records only for internal strategy.

options.label: Explain what a first-time participant brings
options.tradeoff: Resolves a preparation question but uses space that could explain group arrangements.
options.asset: A first-class preparation panel for the booking guide.

options.label: Explain how an organizer requests group places
options.tradeoff: Helps an organizer coordinate several places but adds steps irrelevant to individual learners.
options.asset: A private-group enquiry note for the booking guide.

sources.excerpt: The studio provides practice fabric and basic mending tools for the beginner class.
At the trial desk a first-time participant used the preparation checklist to choose practice fabric.
sources.sample: One staged desk session with a single learner.

sources.excerpt: At a second staged session a first-time participant declined the private-group enquiry note.

research.buyer_problem: At the trial desk a first-time participant used the preparation checklist to choose practice fabric.
research.research_question: What did you check before choosing your first class?
research.evidence_needed: Compare different learners before drawing broader conclusions.

strategy.positioning: Help learners prepare for their first mending session.
strategy.rationale: Every learner wants a private group booking.
strategy.test_hypothesis: A preparation checklist may clarify what to bring.
strategy.measurable_action: Count requests for a class place.
strategy.measurement_method: Count every request as paid attendance.
